sections.title: Build clear past questions
sections.content: For most past questions, use question word + did + subject + base verb. Türkçe ipucu: did’den sonra fiilin yalın hâli gelir.

questions.prompt: Which question asks about an exact clock time?
choices: What time did the class start?

questions.prompt: Complete the question: “Where ___ you meet your friend?”
Choose the natural question about a reason.

sections.title: When or what time?
sections.content: Use when for a general time or date. Use what time when you need the exact hour and minutes.

choices: What time did the shop open?

questions.prompt: Choose the best question for “Last Friday.”

sections.title: Mini interview
sections.content: Ask and answer these aloud: “What did you do yesterday?” “When did you start?” “What time did you finish?” Then add one follow-up question with who, where, or why.
